home.title: Find a Korean tutor. Start with a song you already love.

faq.a: It is where learners outside Korea find a Korean tutor and start with a song they already know.
Ojakgyo is a free consult on a tutor’s page. It stays open, and it is not included in any paid product.

faq.q: Does the site charge for a lesson?
faq.a: Not yet. The site does not take payment. Requesting a first lesson does not charge you here.

faq.q: Are the experience pack and the recommended slot for sale?
faq.a: No. They are not for sale, and this site lists no price for them.
Find a tutor, open Ojakgyo on their page, and request a first lesson only if you both want to continue.
